The '''multiphase hypertechnology anachron sensor array''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] equipment. Individuals with a high degree of technical knowledge and aptitude could repair the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] if needed.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The multiphase hypertechnology anachron sensor array had only a brief mention in [[1987]] in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|First Edition core rulebook]] of [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] of [[West End Games]], designed by [[Greg Costikyan]].
